capabilities: Chat with local LLM agents rooted at the vault via Pi and Ollama
Review and approve proposed Markdown edits as visible diffs before any write
Maintain .agent.md agent profiles, prompt files, and memory files in a Sidekick/ folder
Suggest internal links between notes and export chats to Markdown
extras: Alpha software and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Extensive safety section: reads the vault by default, blocks deletes and shell commands, web fetch off by default, no telemetry, and warns that chat data in .obsidian/plugins/local-sidekick/data.json is private. Requires manual Pi model configuration in ~/.pi/agent/models.json.
motivation: The author wanted to use local LLM agents through a simple interactive chat sidebar in Obsidian via Ollama and the Pi agent harness.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a local, vault-aware LLM agent without sending data to a cloud service or installing a heavy dashboard-style plugin.

relations.evidence: Local Sidekick is a local-first LLM sidebar for Obsidian, for Pi and Ollama users
Prompts go to your local Ollama and nowhere else.
use the terminal plugin alongside this so you never have to leave Obsidian!

summary: Local LLM agent chat sidebar that runs Pi and Ollama models against your vault with read-only tools and approval-gated edit proposals.
